'''Lourdes' father''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] of a [[Lourdes' homeworld|small planetoid]] and was known for his benevolent rule. He was an [[elfish humanoid]], and was thought to be the best swordsman in the system. He was killed by the invading [[Yahk-Tosh]] warlord [[Gar-Oth]].
